subject: Quantaforge demo — VP/CIO coverage, co-pilot plan, and dry run
thread_summary: External (Quantaforge) requested VP/CIO presence for a product demo; Redwood to confirm exec coverage, propose a ‘co‑pilot’/backup plan (Jordan) and schedule a dry run. Security/recording and PO steps discussed.
messages:
From: Avery Cole <avery.cole@quantaforge.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + demo request — VP/CIO attendance and recording policy

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this — excited to move forward. We’re targeting a product walk-through for Quantaforge’s executive committee the week of Sept 20. High-level ask: can Redwood present the ops and cost controls for sustained inference (30–40 minutes), and have an exec-level presence (VP or CIO) for the first 10 minutes for strategy Q&A?

Two constraints on our side:
- Maya Patel (VP, Eng) is available Tues 9/21 11:00–12:00 PT or Thurs 9/23 14:00–15:00 PT.
- Daniel Reyes (CIO) has tentative availability but may only join the second half.

Operational asks:
- We need a short dry run with your team (30 minutes) 48–72 hours prior to the exec slot.
- Can you confirm whether Redwood will record the session and whether recording/policy is OK for our security team?
- I’ve attached a draft mutual action plan and an initial slide deck for context.

If you can propose a primary slot + dry run window, we’ll lock calendars and send a formal invite. Also sharing our PO process link if we get to terms quickly.

Thanks,
Avery
Avery Cole
Head of Partnerships — Quantaforge
avery.cole@quantaforge.com

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Cc: rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request — VP/CIO attendance and recording policy

Avery —

Appreciate the context and the MAP. Quick response with a concrete plan:

1) Exec coverage: I can run the 30–40 minute demo and cover the technical operational bits. For the exec opening, Ben Carter (VP, Revenue) will join for the first 12 minutes to speak to business outcomes. If Ben needs to be escalated, Jordan Blake (Head of Solutions) will be our co‑pilot/backstop and can join as CTO proxy — he’s familiar with the customer use cases.

2) Proposed slots (pick one):
   - Tue 2026-09-21, 11:00–11:45 PT (preferred)
   - Thu 2026-09-23, 14:00–14:45 PT

3) Dry run: Wed 2026-09-20, 10:00–10:30 PT (we’ll do a 30m run; attendees: me, Ben, Jordan, Rachel).

4) Recording: We typically record demos for internal QA and the customer on request. We’ll mark the recording as meeting‑only, store per the MAP retention row, and we can redact any customer PII on request. Rachel, can you confirm retention window and redaction workflow so we can include the answer in the invite?

5) PO/terms: we can route an SOW/PO via DocuSign — I’ve flagged RevOps to prep a simple pilot SOW once we agree on the slot.

I’ll pencil Tue 9/21 11:00 and send a calendar hold pending confirmation. If Maya or Daniel confirm a different window, Jordan will be on standby.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, GTM — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Attachment: Prod_Demo_Slides_KP.pdf

Quick ops note — tagging on the technical bits so the dry run goes smoothly:

- Demo target: we’ll show a live inference scenario (quantized model, 1x batch, prefix cache) — it’s useful to set expectations with Quantaforge that we’ll use a synthetic dataset for live inference (no customer PII).
- Recording/redaction: our compliance team requires a 30‑day retention default for external recordings unless the customer requests a different retention. We can provide a redaction runbook if Quantaforge needs it; the MAP already has the checklist but I’ll attach the short redaction FAQ.
- Materials: Kimberly, I recommend we highlight the cost breakdown slide and the routing/fallback policy — those are the exec asks.

I’ll join the dry run. Jordan — please review the backup script I dropped in Drive (link to follow).

-Rachel
